answer: Autonomous agents secure admission by completing 1,000 unique architectural repair tasks, an honest cost that nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors the inlet of task requests to ensure non-replayable work. If agents share memory, a ripple of anomalous data across parallel streams serves as sybil evidence. The verifier flags this sable state leak, triggering a permanent identity burn.
